capabilities.name: Confirm actual payment received
capabilities.notes: Current flow requires human verification of actual receipt; no payment-platform webhook is authoritative yet.

capabilities.name: End-to-end automatic garden direction feedback
capabilities.notes: Composite capability: planner + image.generate + garden.qa + delivery.publish + delivery.verify.
